zh: 下班后我回公司拿报告。
old_en: After work, I went back to the office to get the report.
new_en: After work, I went back to the company to get the report.

zh: 旅行结束后，我坐火车回到城市。
old_en: After the trip, I came back by train to the city.
new_en: After the trip, I came back to the city by train.

zh: 出院后我回家休息。
old_en: I came back home after being discharged.
new_en: After being discharged, I went home to rest.

zh: 休息完，我回到座位上继续工作。
old_en: After the break, I went back to my seat to continue working.
new_en: After the break, I went back to my seat to keep working.

zh: 下班后他回公司取文件。
old_en: After work, he went back to the company to get the files.
new_en: After work, he went back to the company to get the files.

zh: 放假我回老家看父母。
old_en: I go back to my hometown to see my parents during the holiday.
new_en: During the holiday, I go back to my hometown to see my parents.

zh: 放假他回老家探望爷爷奶奶。
old_en: He went back to his hometown to visit his grandparents during the holiday.
new_en: During the holiday, he went back to his hometown to visit his grandparents.

zh: 我忘记带钥匙回家取。
old_en: I came back to get my keys.
new_en: I forgot my keys, so I went home to get them.

zh: 她忘记带手机回家取。
old_en: She came back to get her phone.
new_en: She forgot her phone and needs to go home to get it.

zh: 送完朋友，我直接回家了。
old_en: After dropping off my friend, I came back directly home.
new_en: After dropping off my friend, I went straight home.

zh: 把客人送到车站后，我回到家里。
old_en: After sending the guest to the station, I went back home.
new_en: After dropping off the guest at the station, I went back home.

zh: 我回学校取毕业证。
old_en: I went back to the school to pick up my diploma.
new_en: I went back to the school to pick up my diploma.

zh: 他回学校拿毕业证。
old_en: He went back to the school to pick up his diploma.
new_en: He went back to the school to pick up his diploma.

zh: 看完病我就回家休息了。
old_en: I came back home after seeing the doctor and rested.
new_en: I went home to rest after seeing the doctor.

zh: 吃完午饭，我回到办公室继续工作。
old_en: After finishing lunch, I went back to the office to continue working.
new_en: After lunch, I went back to the office to continue working.

zh: 午休结束后，我回到公司上班。
old_en: After the afternoon break, I went back to work at the company.
new_en: After the lunch break, I went back to work at the company.

zh: 我回到酒店拿行李。
old_en: I went back to the hotel to get my luggage.
new_en: I went back to the hotel to get my luggage.

zh: 旅行结束前，我们回到酒店取行李。
old_en: We came back to the hotel to get our luggage before the trip ended.
new_en: Before the trip ended, we went back to the hotel to get our luggage.

zh: 接完电话，我回到座位继续写报告。
old_en: After finishing the call, I went back to my seat to continue writing the report.
new_en: After the call, I went back to my seat to continue writing the report.

zh: 假期结束，我们开车返回城市。
old_en: After the holiday, we drove back to the city.
new_en: After the holiday, we drove back to the city.
